attributes.description: Per-instance CloudSQL PostgreSQL metrics, adapted from the Elastic GCP integration dashboard. Covers 22 instances across 4 GCP projects, keyed on gcp.labels.resource.database_id. Three panels will render empty in this cluster and that is expected, not a fault: Database Network Connections (gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.database.network.connections.count is not populated — use num_backends for connection counts) and both Replication panels (replication.replica_lag.sec is not populated; no read replicas are configured).
